en.title: User management
en.subtitle: Manage members and API keys for this instance. Workspace access is configured on each key.
en.name: Name
en.userHelp: Users group API keys. Disabling a user blocks all their keys. Workspace permissions are set on each key.
en.keyHelp: API keys are shown only when created. Save the key before closing; revocation is permanent.
en.grantHelp: Choose which workspaces this key can access and whether it can write data.
en.deleteUserWarning: Delete {name}. All their API keys will stop accepting new requests and cannot be restored. Workspace content is kept.
en.revokeWarning: This key will permanently stop accepting new requests. Accepted tasks are not cancelled. Revocation cannot be undone.
en.secretWarning: Shown only once after creation. Copy and store this API key securely; it cannot be viewed again after closing.
en.loginDescription: Sign in with the instance administrator’s independent UI password. Member API keys cannot be used for web login.
en.readOnlyHelp: Recall, reflect and read knowledge; cannot add, change or delete business data.
en.readWriteHelp: Includes read access, plus retain, memory updates and document deletion.
en.workspaceNameHelp: Use 1–54 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. The name is converted to lowercase and used in API calls.
en.createWorkspaceFirst: Create a workspace first, or choose all workspaces.
en.disabledHelp: This member is disabled. All their API keys are temporarily unavailable. Existing requests are not cancelled.
en.unavailableHelp: Unavailable grants are kept. Rename without changing access, or explicitly remove unavailable workspaces before replacing authorization.
en.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and save the key manually.
en.deleteWorkspaceWarning: Delete {name} and all its memories? This cannot be undone. Stop access to this workspace and wait for existing requests and background work to finish before deleting.
en.createWorkspaceHelp: Enter a name and an optional description.
en.keyIssueUnknown: This issuance result is unknown. The secret cannot be retrieved from the key list. Inspect key IDs, masked suffixes and creation times; explicitly revoke any identified key whose secret was not saved before issuing another. A matching name alone does not identify this attempt.
en.editNeedsCheck: Inspect the current record before starting another edit. The original draft will not be resubmitted with a newer version.
en.newKeyAttempt: I checked the keys — start a new issuance
en.keyRecordsCheck: Inspect the current keys by ID. This list is a current observation, not proof that the previous request finished. No write is replayed.
en.userRecordsCheck: Inspect the current members and their IDs. A matching name does not prove this creation succeeded; absence does not prove the original request stopped.
en.workspaceCheckHelp: This is the current resource at this name. It does not prove that the original creation succeeded or that background work stopped.
en.workspaceAbsent: No workspace is currently visible at {name}. The original request may still be running; do not repeat it automatically.
en.workspaceSuccessor: The name now refers to a different workspace (ID {id}). The original deletion will not be replayed against it.
en.workspaceOriginal: The original workspace is currently {state} (ID {id}). Verify the previous request and stop business activity before any new deletion.
en.workspaceDeleteUnknown: The deletion result is unknown. Check the original resource below; a read does not prove that accepted requests or background work stopped.
en.userNotObserved: No matching record was observed in the current directory.
en.keyNotObserved: This ID is not currently listed.
en.keySecretNotShown: Key {id} was created after you left this page. Its secret is no longer shown and cannot be retrieved. Explicitly revoke this ID before issuing a replacement.
en.workspaceDeleteConflict: The original deletion condition was rejected. Inspect the current workspace identity before selecting a new action. No deletion will be replayed.
en.noMatches: No matches. Clear the search to see all results.
en.emptyWorkspaces: No workspaces yet. Create a workspace to get started.
en.readUnavailable: Data could not be loaded. Retry using Refresh.
en.staleResults: Refresh failed. Previously loaded data is not current; retry using Refresh.
en.managementRestriction: Neither permission allows managing workspaces, members or API keys.

zh-CN.title: 用户管理
zh-CN.subtitle: 管理当前实例的成员与 API Key，工作空间权限在 Key 上设置。
zh-CN.allSpaces: 全部工作空间（包含未来新创建工作空间）
zh-CN.name: 名称
zh-CN.userHelp: 成员用于归属 API Key；工作空间权限在每把 Key 上配置，不自动创建 Key。
zh-CN.keyHelp: 完整 API Key 仅签发成功时展示一次。吊销后无法恢复。
zh-CN.grantHelp: 选择这把 Key 可访问的工作空间，以及是否允许修改内容。
zh-CN.deleteUserWarning: 删除 {name} 后，其全部 API Key 将失效，无法恢复。工作空间和记忆数据保留。
zh-CN.revokeWarning: 吊销后，这把 API Key 将永久失效，无法恢复。使用它的应用无法继续发起新请求；已受理的任务不会被取消。
zh-CN.secretWarning: API Key仅在创建成功后展示一次。请复制并安全保存，关闭后无法再次查看。
zh-CN.loginDescription: 请输入实例管理员的独立 UI 口令。成员 API Key 不能用于网页登录。
zh-CN.readOnlyHelp: 允许记忆检索（Recall）、反思（Reflect）和知识读取；不允许新增、修改或删除业务数据。
zh-CN.readWriteHelp: 包含只读能力，并允许写入记忆（Retain）、修改记忆、删除文档等业务操作。
zh-CN.workspaceNameHelp: 使用 1–54 位英文字母、数字或下划线，以字母开头。名称统一转为小写，用于 API 调用。
zh-CN.createWorkspaceFirst: 请先创建工作空间，或选择全部工作空间。
zh-CN.disabledHelp: 成员已停用，其全部 API Key 暂不可用；已受理的请求不受影响。
zh-CN.unavailableHelp: 已保留不可用空间授权。可以只改名称；替换授权前，请明确移除不可用空间。
zh-CN.copyFailed: 复制失败，请手动选中并保存。
zh-CN.deleteWorkspaceWarning: 删除 {name} 及其全部记忆数据？删除后无法恢复。请先停止该空间访问，并等待现有请求及后台任务结束。
zh-CN.noAccessibleSpaces: 无可访问的工作空间，请编辑授权
zh-CN.createWorkspaceHelp: 填写工作空间名称和可选的描述信息。
zh-CN.workspaceSubmitting: 正在等待服务端返回结果。
zh-CN.keyIssueUnknown: 本次签发结果未知。Key 列表无法补取明文。请按 Key ID、脱敏尾缀和创建时间核对；明确识别出未保存明文的 Key 后，先手动吊销，再另行签发。仅名称相同不能认定属于本次请求。
zh-CN.editNeedsCheck: 请先核对当前记录，再开始新的编辑。不会将新版本自动套用到原草稿重新提交。
zh-CN.newKeyAttempt: 已核对 Key，开始新的签发
zh-CN.keyRecordsCheck: 请按 ID 核对当前 Key。列表仅表示当前观察，不证明原请求已经结束；不会重放写入。
zh-CN.userRecordsCheck: 请核对当前成员及其 ID。同名存在不证明本次创建成功；当前不存在也不证明原请求已停止。
zh-CN.workspaceCheckHelp: 这是当前名称对应的资源，不证明原创建请求成功，也不证明后台工作已停止。
zh-CN.workspaceAbsent: 当前未查到空间 {name}。原请求仍可能在执行，请勿自动重发。
zh-CN.workspaceSuccessor: 该名称当前属于另一个空间（ID {id}）。不会将原删除请求重放到该空间。
zh-CN.workspaceOriginal: 原空间当前状态为 {state}（ID {id}）。再次删除前，请核对原请求，并停止业务访问及等待已有工作结束。
zh-CN.workspaceDeleteUnknown: 本次删除结果未知。请核对下方原资源；一次查询不能证明已受理请求或后台工作已停止。
zh-CN.userNotObserved: 当前目录中未查到匹配记录。
zh-CN.keyObserved: 当前列表中存在此 ID。
zh-CN.keyNotObserved: 当前列表中未查到此 ID。
zh-CN.keySecretNotShown: 离开此页面后，Key {id} 已创建成功。明文已不再显示，且无法补取。签发替代 Key 前，请明确吊销此 ID。
zh-CN.workspaceDeleteConflict: 原删除条件已被拒绝。请先核对当前空间身份，再明确选择新的操作；不会重放删除请求。
zh-CN.noMatches: 没有匹配结果。清空搜索后查看全部结果。
zh-CN.emptyWorkspaces: 还没有工作空间，请先创建工作空间。
zh-CN.readUnavailable: 无法读取数据，请点击刷新重试。
zh-CN.staleResults: 刷新失败，之前读取的数据不是最新结果，请点击刷新重试。
zh-CN.managementRestriction: 两种权限均不允许管理工作空间、用户或 API Key。
